_purpose: Problem 8. Tier 1 templates (0 tokens) for common emails, slot extractors, tone map and word-limit rules for the validator.

formal.ask: I would be grateful for your approval.
formal.thanks: Thank you for your time and consideration.

leave_request.subject: Leave Request
leave_request.body: I would like to request {duration} of leave{reason_clause}. {ask}

handover.text: I will ensure that my pending tasks are managed before my leave.

leave_request.missing_slot_rule: use placeholders.dates or omit the clause; never invent a reason

seed_examples.request: Write an email to my manager requesting two days of leave due to a family function. Keep it polite and professional, and limit it to 50 words.
seed_examples.note: Template output is about 32 words and fits the 50-word limit.
